check.title: ObjectScript: arquivos, stream e global privada
check.objective: Cria pasta, grava com %Stream, renomeia, lê, edita a versão numa global ^|| e apaga tudo
check.run: $XECUTE("() set dir=##class(%File).NormalizeDirectory(""consisterm-selftest-""_$JOB,$SYSTEM.Util.ManagerDirectory()_""Temp""),ok=##class(%File).CreateDirectoryChain(dir),f=dir_""settings.env"",g=dir_""moved.env"",s=##class(%Stream.FileCharacter).%New() do s.LinkToFile(f),s.WriteLine(""APP_VERSION=8.0.46b2""),s.%Save() kill s set ok=ok&&##class(%File).Rename(f,g),s=##class(%Stream.FileCharacter).%New() do s.LinkToFile(g) set ^||selftest=$REPLACE(s.ReadLine(),""8.0.46b2"",""8.0.46b3"") kill s set ok=ok&&(^||selftest=""APP_VERSION=8.0.46b3""),ok=ok&&##class(%File).RemoveDirectoryTree(dir) kill ^||selftest set o=##class(%DynamicObject).%New() do o.%Set(""status"",$SELECT(ok:""ok"",1:""error"")),o.%Set(""summary"",$SELECT(ok:""pasta, stream, rename, global privada e texto editado"",1:""uma operacao falhou"")) quit o.%ToJSON()")
